question: Should OpenClaw still support or backport the removed `skills/skill-creator/scripts/init_skill.py --resources` helper for released users, or should current Skill Workshop guidance retire that path?
rationale: Automation can verify the released parser behavior and the open fix candidate, but current main removed the helper and current docs/instructions make Skill Workshop the durable creation surface.

options.title: Retire the helper path
options.body: Confirm Skill Workshop is the intended replacement, then close the linked PR and this issue as no longer planned for core.

options.title: Backport the parser repair
options.body: Keep the released helper supported by refreshing or backporting resource-token normalization and focused tests without restoring obsolete workflow guidance.

recommendation.title: Retire the helper path
recommendation.body: Confirm Skill Workshop is the intended replacement, then close the linked PR and this issue as no longer planned for core.

likelyOwner.reason: The original bundled skill/helper surface and adjacent packaging history point most strongly to this owner for the support-boundary decision.
